description: Felix Platzer deposited this supplementary dataset at Graz University of Technology for research on rail rutting corrugation. It contains contact-pressure, slip-velocity and local-wear distributions for combinations of wavelength, wheel-rail contact model and chirp amplitude. Each scenario covers the timesteps during passage of one wavelength. The distributions are longitudinal sections at the lateral position of maximum wear. A ZIP archive contains MP4 animations and their individual PNG frames, with comparisons among five contact models and several amplitudes. The repository provides public file access under CC BY 4.0 at no stated charge. These are simulation results for studying railway wear mechanisms and comparing contact-model behaviour. They are not a measured national rail-condition inventory. Numeric source arrays are not listed separately in the metadata. The associated paper is described as submitted to Vehicle System Dynamics; publication acceptance was not verified. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
